payload.text: ccusage herdr install says nothing while herdr-app check runs, and the check can take minutes: on hv's install (vc, 2026-11-13) it took about two, because Herdr runs it as a background GUI job, which waited on the window server under a load average of about 230, so install looked hung. Before the check, say what install is waiting for, and consider bounding the wait, with a check that has not returned in time reported as not run rather than as failed. vc's word: nothing to build now; it waits for vc's go.
